info.description: The Stack19 developer API. TEST MODE only: keys start with `sk_test_`, every call is simulated, nothing is dialled or sent, and every answer carries `Stack19-Mode: test`. Send `Authorization: Bearer sk_test_...`. 60 requests a minute per key (`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `Retry-After` on 429). Every refusal has the one body `{error: {code, message, retry_after, request_id}}`; the codes are listed in docs/contracts/error-codes.md. Contract: docs/contracts/developer-api.md.
info.title: Stack19 developer API
